profile.headline: Software Engineer Lead
profile.summary: Motivated Software Engineer with a proven track record writing scalable customer-facing products as part of an Agile organization. Proven ability to lead development on MVPs, work on cross-functional teams, and gather requirements. Adaptable professional comfortable designing a feature, demoing a product, or writing software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Demonstrated leadership by playing a pivotal role in the development and support of several business-critical, greenfield applications. Designed event-driven tools that automated the delivery of firmware updates to vehicles; authored an analytics library used widely across the business unit.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Functioned as a software engineer on the customer-facing platform team to develop new back-end features for a legacy enterprise workforce education tool. Maintained code quality through rigorous testing and documentation.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Served as a consultant in the financial sector to develop business solutions using software-as-a- service tools. Studied for and passed the Oracle Java 8 Developer exam.
